entities.name: Estrogen receptor beta P57782
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Oncorhynchus mykiss estrogen receptor beta (UniProt P57782); 568 aa.
Predicted nuclear hormone receptor: estrogen-responsive transcription factor with sequence-specific DNA binding and estrogen binding.
Pfam domains: ERbeta_N (PF12497, aa 46–153), zf-C4 (PF00105, aa 177–245), Hormone_recep (PF00104, aa 323–519).
Reference annotation: nuclear localization; homodimeric DNA binding; estrogen-response-element-dependent activation; can heterodimerize with ER-alpha by similarity.
Sequence-derived estimates: 63,812.73 Da; pI 7.087; GRAVY -0.3137; instability index 65.948.
